strongest_objections: The reviewed snapshot necessarily contains a null review_snapshot_commit, so candidate equality is not self-proven by that JSON alone. The durable recovery_position is an exact dynamic algorithm rather than a copy-paste operator script. It now removes the unsafe static candidate and nine-commit inventory, specifies the baseline-exclusive range and newest-first order, and is reproducible by a Git-capable operator, but novice execution still depends on understanding the documented Git primitives.

The rollback job installs validation dependencies before applying the reverts. That could weaken a future rehearsal if the candidate changed dependency declarations, although the reviewed baseline-to-snapshot diff changes neither requirements-dev.txt nor pyproject.toml, and the resulting tree exactly equals the baseline tree before baseline validation and ten regression tests pass.

The validator authenticates the exact-head successful rollback job through GitHub rather than parsing the uploaded receipt during closure. learning_records.residual_risk: Authority inventory changes must update the explicit surface manifest or validation fails closed.
learning_records.apivr_next_action: Treat prohibited maturity wording as a machine-enforced contract axis distinct from canonical identity terms.

learning_records.affected_invariant: Immutable JSON read from Git must be decoded with the repository's declared UTF-8 encoding before canonical hashing.
learning_records.expected_result: The same committed program blob produces the same evidence-package hash on Windows and Linux.

observed_evidence.assertion: The UTF-8 em-dash fixture and historical snapshot preflight pass on Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13 on both Windows and Linux.

learning_records.learning: subprocess text mode inherits the host locale unless an encoding is explicit; canonical evidence must use byte reads followed by strict UTF-8 decoding or one centralized loader.
learning_records.recurrence_signature: A Git JSON blob hashes differently by operating system while its raw bytes and stored canonical hash are unchanged.
learning_records.guardrail: All historical program loading routes through _load_object_at_commit, which decodes Git bytes as utf-8-sig; a non-ASCII mutation fixture fails if locale-dependent decoding returns.

verification_evidence.assertion: Exact-head run 30737167612 passed 476 tests and all cross-platform runtime matrices.

learning_records.rollback_position: Preserve the centralized UTF-8 loader and its non-ASCII regression; do not restore locale-dependent subprocess text decoding.
learning_records.residual_risk: Future direct Git subprocess consumers outside the centralized loader require the same explicit encoding discipline.
learning_records.apivr_next_action: Reject locale-dependent decoding for any canonical repository artifact.

learning_records.affected_invariant: Repository-wide typing must resolve each source module exactly once and must validate the same target set in local certification and CI.
learning_records.expected_result: Strict mypy analysis succeeds for all critical packages and quality, security, and release scripts without duplicate identities or untyped payload escapes.

observed_evidence.assertion: Mutations prove that removing explicit package bases, weakening import following, or changing the exact CI type-check command is rejected.

learning_records.learning: Namespace-style script directories require an explicit module-base policy before file-list mypy invocation can be treated as deterministic; correcting module discovery can reveal real downstream type debt that must also be fixed rather than excluded.
learning_records.recurrence_signature: Mypy reports one scripts file under both a top-level and scripts-qualified module name, or a newly reachable script emits union-attribute or untyped-container errors.
learning_records.guardrail: pyproject.toml fixes explicit_package_bases and follow_imports=normal, CI runs the exact complete target list, and the quality validator mutation-tests both settings and the workflow command.

verification_evidence.assertion: Exact-head run 30741821936 passed the complete strict typing command, all expanded quality mutations, and every certification job.

learning_records.rollback_position: Preserve explicit package bases, normal import following, the exact target inventory, and typed SBOM payloads as one verification boundary.
learning_records.residual_risk: New namespace-style source roots must be added deliberately to both the target inventory and module-base policy.
learning_records.apivr_next_action: Treat module discovery configuration as tested executable architecture, not local mypy preference.

learning_records.affected_invariant: A green baseline comparison is not a ratchet unless the baseline, relative dependency graph, status vocabulary, and egress heuristic are themselves adverse-tested against weakening.
learning_records.expected_result: Raising debt allowances, lowering floors, hiding cycles with relative syntax, returning an unknown status, or adding a statically identifiable egress client all fail certification.

observed_evidence.assertion: The rework binds both rounds of independent-review counterexamples to exact history, workflow, monotonic, regeneration, architecture, egress, and runtime-status mutations.

learning_records.learning: A machine-readable baseline is still self-authorized unless immutable minima and prior committed state constrain it; parsers and trust-boundary enums require adversarial syntax and unknown-value cases, not only happy-path inventory checks.
learning_records.recurrence_signature: Current CI is green while a same-commit baseline edit, relative-import cycle, unknown status, or new browser/process client returns zero validation errors.
learning_records.guardrail: Canonical defaults and coverage minima are code-owned; Git history forbids allowance growth; tightening is hash-approved and reduction-only; relative imports resolve canonically; the status vocabulary is closed; static egress imports and literal calls require accountable inventory.

verification_evidence.assertion: Twenty architecture tests plus monotonic-quality and runtime-boundary suites passed in exact-head run 30741821936.

learning_records.rollback_position: Preserve every independent-review counterexample and its fail-closed implementation as one bounded Phase 3 verification boundary.
learning_records.residual_risk: Git history must remain available and static egress analysis does not claim arbitrary whole-program data-flow proof.
learning_records.apivr_next_action: Require reviewers to mutate each validator's own authority and alternate syntax before accepting a green baseline.

learning_records.affected_invariant: Required evidence semantics and critical coverage floors must remain consistent across focused tests, the full suite, workflow gating, and coverage certification.
learning_records.expected_result: Required needs-review evidence blocks, optional non-success remains isolated, and changed trust-boundary branches remain above their fixed risk floor.

observed_evidence.assertion: Required and optional status matrices pass, the stale content-intelligence expectation is corrected, and exact CI reports 534 passing tests with every critical floor green.

learning_records.learning: A focused boundary suite can miss an older consumer expectation, and new failure branches can lower risk coverage even when repository coverage rises; full-suite and per-file floors are separate mandatory gates.
learning_records.recurrence_signature: Focused status tests pass but a legacy consumer expects PARTIAL for required evidence, or repository coverage passes while runtime/tools.py falls below its critical threshold.
learning_records.guardrail: Run the full suite after status changes and add optional plus required status-path tests before accepting the fixed critical-file coverage report.

verification_evidence.assertion: The exact semantic consumer and 534-test coverage matrix pass in run 30741821936; runtime/tools.py exceeds its unchanged 83 percent floor.

learning_records.rollback_position: Keep required non-success blocking semantics, optional isolation tests, the corrected consumer assertion, and the unchanged critical floor together.
learning_records.residual_risk: Future status additions must update both the closed vocabulary and required or optional evidence mapping with coverage.
learning_records.apivr_next_action: Treat full-suite semantic compatibility and critical-file coverage as independent post-refactor checks.

learning_records.affected_invariant: Repository certification must depend only on tracked source artifacts, not permissions or contents of ignored local caches.
learning_records.expected_result: An unreadable ignored pytest cache cannot prevent JSON or Markdown validation of tracked repository documents.

observed_evidence.assertion: A source regression requires git ls-files for document enumeration and rejects recursive root scanning.

learning_records.learning: Filtering generated paths after recursive enumeration is too late when directory traversal itself can fail; tracked inventory must be the enumeration source.
learning_records.recurrence_signature: validate-repository.ps1 fails before reading a tracked document because Get-ChildItem traverses an ignored cache or generated directory with restrictive ACLs.
learning_records.guardrail: JSON and Markdown validation enumerate only git-tracked files, with a regression forbidding recursive root document scans.

verification_evidence.assertion: Canonical repository validation and all six matrices pass in exact-head run 30741821936 despite the local ignored-cache ACL counterexample.

learning_records.rollback_position: Preserve tracked-only enumeration and its source regression; never restore root-recursive discovery for tracked document validation.
learning_records.residual_risk: Tracked files with unreadable ACLs still fail as intended because source evidence itself would be unavailable.
learning_records.apivr_next_action: Use source-control inventory before filesystem traversal for repository certification.

learning_records.affected_invariant: Monotonic and architecture certification must fail closed when their proof prerequisites or supported syntax variants disappear.
learning_records.expected_result: Missing prior history, no pinned full-history checkout, removed or weakened coverage execution, package-import cycles, and imported egress aliases all fail exact CI policy or architecture validation.

observed_evidence.assertion: The quality suite requires prior history, at least one immutable checkout with fetch-depth zero, exact package coverage and report paths, the canonical floor, and exact risk-report consumption.

learning_records.learning: A control that depends on Git history or a workflow command must validate that prerequisite explicitly, and import analysis must resolve known submodules and imported callable aliases rather than only module-qualified syntax.
learning_records.recurrence_signature: The validator reports no errors after history, checkout, coverage, or risk validation is removed, or after equivalent Python behavior is expressed through from-import package or callable aliases.
learning_records.guardrail: Canonical validation rejects unavailable prior history; workflow checks require a discovered pinned checkout with fetch-depth zero and exact coverage-to-risk command binding; architecture uses known-module two-pass resolution and alias-aware static egress calls.

verification_evidence.assertion: Exact-head run 30741821936 passed 534 tests, twenty architecture counterexamples, quality workflow mutations, all supported matrices, and dynamic rollback.

learning_records.rollback_position: Preserve history and workflow prerequisite checks with known-module and imported-alias analysis as one closure boundary.
learning_records.residual_risk: Static egress remains intentionally bounded to recognized imports and literal calls; arbitrary whole-program data flow is not claimed.
learning_records.apivr_next_action: For every proof prerequisite, test both removal of the prerequisite and alternate syntax for the protected behavior.
